classification.difficultyReason: Cosine rule for an angle from three sides, then SAS area; same structure.

content.prompt: Use cosine rule to find an angle, and hence calculate the area of this triangle to 1 d.p.

answer.worked:
Let $\theta$ be the angle opposite the $17\text{ cm}$ side.
$$\begin{align*}\cos\theta&=\frac{11^2+14^2-17^2}{2(11)(14)}\\\theta&=\cos^{-1}\!\left(\frac{28}{308}\right)\approx84.8^\circ\end{align*}$$
Using the unrounded angle,
$$\begin{align*}A&=\frac12 ab\sin\theta\\A&=\frac12(11)(14)\sin\!\left(\cos^{-1}\!\left(\frac{28}{308}\right)\right)\\A&\approx76.7\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$
